neighbours.label: framing of possibility or likelihood (potential, likely, conceivable, can, easy to imagine): the slot where a sentence says something might happen rather than that it did
fire: The new drug has the potential to reduce hospital stays for older patients.
Drivers are more likely to speed on wide, empty roads.
It is conceivable that the letter was written by someone else entirely.
Small changes in diet can make a big difference to energy levels.
It is easy to imagine how the plan might go wrong.
Volunteers are likely to drop out if the training is too long.
The festival has the potential to bring thousands of visitors to the town.
Too much salt can raise blood pressure over time.
quiet: The new drug reduced hospital stays for older patients last year.
Drivers sped on the wide, empty road last night.
The letter was written by her brother in 1952.
Small changes in diet made a big difference to her energy levels.
The plan went wrong on the second day.
Volunteers dropped out because the training was too long.
The festival brought thousands of visitors to the town in June.
Too much salt raised his blood pressure over the winter.
